findings.title: Route handler without an authentication boundary
findings.description: An HTTP route handler is defined with no detectable authentication dependency, decorator, or middleware reference. Critical functions must enforce authZ.
findings.recommendation: Attach an auth dependency/decorator (e.g. FastAPI Depends(require_api_key)) or enforce it in a global middleware so every /api/* route is gated.

summary: 1 High severity issue detected. Authentication boundary should be remediated.
